mapper.sql: id, user_id, title, summary, category, tags, pinned, views, version, content_hash, deleted, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note (id, user_id, title, summary, category, tags, pinned, views, version, content_hash, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{category}, #{tags}, #{pinned}, #{views}, #{version}, #{contentHash}, #{deleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE note SET title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, category = #{category}, tags = #{tags}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE note SET deleted = 1, deleted_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE note SET views = views + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE note SET pinned = #{pinned}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{noteId} AND user_id = #{userId}
